front.anchor: cx = 24 (skin-region centre), ey = top iris row; measured Raven ey = cell y+21 (+1 for middle walk column), base ey = cell y+19+walk bob. Left/right refer to image-space.

source.how: Erase sclera/iris with s and retain one four-pixel closed lid at iris+1.
Close only image-left eye using the closed lid; keep original right eye.
Close only image-right eye using the closed lid; keep original left eye.
Step upper lids down toward the centre by one row; preserve lower iris rows.
Step upper lids down toward the outside by one row; preserve lower iris rows.
Replace outer iris columns with w, retaining a one-column pupil and the original box.
Erase iris with s and bend the retained dark lid into a three-pixel raised arc.
Replace only the named eye with a five-pixel p band and rounded patch; erase remaining iris with s.
Change one descending column of the named open eye to c; retain the other eye.
Erase the named iris with s, retain its closed lid and add a descending c scar; other eye stays normal.
Replace only the named eye with a five-pixel p band and rounded patch; erase remaining iris with s.
Change one descending column of the named open eye to c; retain the other eye.
Erase the named iris with s, retain its closed lid and add a descending c scar; other eye stays normal.
Rearrange original brow pixels into inward-down angry or outward-down sad steps; happy/surprised lift the four-pixel arc one row.
Rearrange original brow pixels into inward-down angry or outward-down sad steps; happy/surprised lift the four-pixel arc one row.

Add a three-pixel m line to the originally mouthless skin.
Add two m corners and a three-pixel lower arc to the originally mouthless skin.
Add a three-by-three m rim with an unpainted centre to the originally mouthless skin.
Add a three-by-three m rim with one central t chewing/inner-mouth pixel.
Add a three-pixel upper m arc with two lowered corners to the originally mouthless skin.
